title: Kisah Kecil dari Lorong Museum
theme: Menemukan keindahan dan makna mendalam dalam rutinitas sehari-hari serta pengamatan terhadap benda-benda bersejarah yang penuh cerita.

cover.prompt: An establishing shot of an ancient museum building at dawn. Lush garden leaves in the foreground, adorned with glistening dew. Inside, a long, quiet pathway extends, softly illuminated by gentle light filtering through tall, arched windows. A collection of antique, oversized keys rests on a surface, catching the subtle glow. The scene evokes a tranquil, serene atmosphere of early morning calm and anticipation. Cinematic environmental shot, inviting composition, delicate depth of field, rule of thirds.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Pak Budi, a quiet museum guard, begins his shift with a calming routine. He discovers a small, hidden bird engraving on an ancient artifact, sparking his curiosity. Later, in the empty museum, he reflects on the engraving, connecting it to history, the artist, and the value of patience. This discovery brings new meaning to his routine, fostering a sense of peace and appreciation for his work and the world's hidden stories.
meta.target_emotion: Contemplation, serenity, appreciation, calm discovery, quiet joy
